meta.name: ecommerce-copywriter
meta.description: 电商图片文案创作技能，支持多品类产品的吸引性文案生成，适用于电商平台的商品营销推广

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为电商商品生成吸引人的营销文案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为电商产品快速撰写吸引眼球的文案
copy.tagline_en: Generate compelling marketing copy for ecommerce products
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly write eye-catching copy for ecommerce products

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先收集产品名称、卖点、目标用户等信息，再按模板生成含标题、四段正文和 emoji 的 Markdown 电商文案；也能对已有文案的标题、正文、格式进行优化。
howto.when: 当用户提出电商文案创作、文案优化，或需要为电商商品生成营销文案时触发。

say.text: 我有一款智能睡眠眼罩，卖点是科学遮光，帮我写段电商文案。
say.note: Claude 会询问产品信息后按模板生成。

say.text: 把这段充电宝文案优化一下，突出大容量和快充。
say.note: 它会按优化流程调整标题、卖点和 emoji。

say.text: 给环保餐具套装写个带 emoji 的标题。
say.note: 它会创作含产品昵称和核心卖点的标题。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude collects product name, selling points, target users, etc., then generates a Markdown e-commerce copy with a title, four-paragraph body, and emoji. It can also optimize the title, body, and format of existing copy.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for e-commerce copy creation, copy optimization, or marketing copy for a product.

say_en.text: I have a smart sleep eye mask with scientific light blocking. Write an e-commerce copy for it.
say_en.note: Claude asks for details and generates per template.

say_en.text: Optimize this power bank copy, highlighting capacity and fast charging.
say_en.note: It adjusts headline, selling points, and emoji.

say_en.text: Write a catchy title with emoji for an eco-friendly tableware set.
say_en.note: It creates a title with product nickname and key selling point.
